expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 protocol work will explore adding a request identifier for correlating messages, a timestamp for recording message creation time, and an optional payload for carrying additional data, while preserving the existing Ping behavior and keeping these fields out of the current release until their design is finalized.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit `v:2` envelope are now supported.
